records.scope: Demo library; saved personal inputs remain available

optionalUnavailable: Complete process safety and lifecycle data

optimization.title: Compare carbonate versus bicarbonate
optimization.concept: Balanced acid-carbonate chemistry permits a sodium-carbonate route. The atom-economy advantage is derived from stoichiometry; this is not a published process-performance comparison.
optimization.problem: Bicarbonate generates more non-target CO₂ and water per mole of citrate.
optimization.limits: No safety, crystallization or environmental superiority is inferred from atom economy alone. Both routes keep the same illustrative target yield and auxiliary inventory.

records.name: Calcium lactate formation
records.scope: Demo library; saved personal inputs remain available
records.reason: Research demonstrates conversion of bivalve-shell carbonate to calcium lactate. Compare a recovered-carbonate feedstock on the same ideal purified-CaCO₃ basis.
optionalUnavailable: Complete process safety and lifecycle data

optimization.title: Compare recovered carbonate feedstock
optimization.concept: Research demonstrates conversion of bivalve-shell carbonate to calcium lactate. Compare a recovered-carbonate feedstock on the same ideal purified-CaCO₃ basis.
optimization.problem: A virgin-only feedstock model ignores potentially useful carbonate-rich waste.
optimization.limits: The paper considers real shells and product hydration; this model retains an anhydrous target and ideal carbonate purity. Cleaning, impurities, transport and hydration need additional inventory. Mass metrics and score correctly stay unchanged.

changes.feedstockOrigin: Recovered shell-derived carbonate · ideal purity assumption

records.name: Calcium carbonate precipitation
records.scope: Demo library; saved personal inputs remain available
records.reason: Aqueous calcium hydroxide carbonation is an established alternative route to calcium carbonate. Its different net equation avoids sodium chloride coproduct.
optionalUnavailable: Complete process safety and lifecycle data

optimization.title: Compare carbonation with salt precipitation
optimization.concept: Aqueous calcium hydroxide carbonation is an established alternative route to calcium carbonate. Its different net equation avoids sodium chloride coproduct.
optimization.problem: The salt route generates sodium chloride as non-target material.
optimization.limits: Lime manufacture, gas handling, particle properties and purification are outside the model. CO₂ as an input is not proof of net carbon removal; no emissions credit is assigned.

optimization.title: Compare enzyme-assisted PLA depolymerization
optimization.concept: Proteinase K-assisted PLA depolymerization is established. Compare an enzyme-containing scenario with an assumed shorter duration.
optimization.problem: An insoluble polymer can resist hydrolysis; reaction rate is absent from the mass balance.
optimization.limits: The lower duration is an illustrative input, not a measured rate. Polymer morphology, molecular weight, buffers and enzyme preparation affect performance; no universal operating conditions are implied.

records.name: PET hydrolysis to terephthalic acid
records.scope: Demo library; saved personal inputs remain available
records.reason: Ideal polymer repeat units; terephthalic acid is the only credited target. Ethylene glycol is non-target material in this boundary. Research on PET-PE packaging demonstrates enzymatic PET depolymerization without amorphization pretreatment and at high solids loading. Model a reduced preparation inventory and less auxiliary water.
optionalUnavailable: Complete process safety and lifecycle data

optimization.title: Compare PET recycling without amorphization
optimization.concept: Research on PET-PE packaging demonstrates enzymatic PET depolymerization without amorphization pretreatment and at high solids loading. Model a reduced preparation inventory and less auxiliary water.
optimization.baseline: Enzymatic PET recycling with a preparation-material allowance
optimization.problem: Additional pretreatment and dilute processing can increase material demand.
optimization.limits: This is ideal PET-repeat-unit accounting, not a measured PET-PE batch. PE, additives, enzyme production, buffer chemistry and monomer purification are not resolved. No thermal-energy saving is inferred.

changes.processRoute: PET hydrolysis without amorphization · accounting scenario
